headline: Grumpy Walrus woke up at 8:27 AM. It sold ~1.01M SOLADA for ~2,071 ADA in one swap at 8:47 AM, which crosses the 1M SOLADA dump line (SOLADA was already Pass). It also dumped 7M BEAST, ~1.96M Guinea Pig, 10k COCK, 250k MEPE and 250k Quantum SNEK into NIGHT (~5.3k NIGHT added overall), sold 10M SURFY (~26 ADA) and 250k MEPE (~136 ADA), sent ~1.25k ADA and 2M MISS to outside wallets, and bought small clips of COCK (~14.6k), CITY (~0.89M, ~22.5M held) and FLOW (~600). Net ADA ~+34. ASCEND untouched (~325.0k held). Zippy Lemur bought ~1,448 ASCEND for ~1,502 ADA at 9:53 AM. COCK side ~141.5k, 5.7% under its line. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket; CITY gate ~11:44 AM with pool ~18.7k (under 25k).
learned: Lessons: Grumpy Walrus sold ~1.01M SOLADA in a single swap while the pre-filter showed ~998k net (a small SOLADA receipt came later), so the 1M dump line should be judged per swap, not on the net figure.
